name: Brixham Barber Shop
tagline: Sharp fades, proper scissor work and a straight-razor finish on Brixham Drive.
description: Brixham Barber Shop, 33 Brixham Dr, Coventry CV2 3LA. Skin fades, scissor cuts, beard trims and hot towel shaves. Rated 4.8 from 54 Google reviews. Call 07941 128633.

hoursNote: Call ahead to hold a chair.

services.name: Skin fade
services.note: Zero, drop or taper. Blended from the skin up with a razor line.

services.name: Scissor cut
services.note: Scissor over comb, shaped to your head, styled to finish.

services.name: Cut & beard
services.note: Any cut with a full beard shape-up and hot towel.

services.name: Beard trim
services.note: Lined, tapered, finished with a hot towel and oil.

services.name: Hot towel shave
services.note: Straight razor, two towels, balm to close.

services.name: Kids
services.note: Patient hands and a quick chair. First cuts welcome.

servicesNote: Prices in shop. Cash and card. Walk in, or call ahead to hold a chair.
about: We cut hair on Brixham Drive and we take it seriously. Fades are blended, not buzzed; scissor cuts are shaped to your head, not to a photo on a wall. If you sit in our chair, you leave looking like you meant it.

You'll get the same barber, the same standard and the same straight talk every time. No upsell, no rush, no fuss. That's why the neighbourhood keeps coming back, and why fifty-odd people have left us five stars on Google.

statement.sub: Same barber, same standard, every time.
